Drug repurposing often starts as a hypothesis: a known compound might help treat a disease beyond its original indication. A good example is minoxidil: initially prescribed for hypertension, it later proved useful against hair loss. Knowledge graphs are a natural place to look for such hypotheses because they encode biomedical entities (drugs, genes, phenotypes, diseases) [&#8230;]
